svg.title: Figure 5-1. Gate roadmap G0 to G6 with blockers and the 30-day backlog (WP-M-03 §3, §5, §9)
svg.desc: Phases P0 Governance, P1 Concept, P2 System design, P3 HW/SW development, P4 Integration and verification, P5 Validation and release and P6 Operation, each closed by its gate G0 to G6, with relative durations and effort estimates from §4 and §5. No gate is recorded as passed and no calendar dates are set. Under each phase are its entry conditions from §5 and the open items due at its gate; below are the critical path, the long-lead items and the single-maintainer bottleneck R-01. The bottom panel shows backlog items B-01 to B-17 of §9 by status: B-02, B-03, B-10, B-14 and B-17 done; B-04 and B-07 done with an exception; the other ten not marked done.
svg.text: Figure 5-1 · Gate roadmap G0…G6: no gate passed yet
Phases and gates of §3 with the relative durations of §5 and effort of §4.2 (not to scale; no calendar dates, OI-1) · blockers from §5, §6, §10 · backlog from §9
No gate is recorded as passed · no milestones exist yet (B-01) · the plan is Draft and the schedule is relative only (OI-1)
Entry conditions of each phase (§5 “Depends on”) and open items due at its gate (§10)
Due G0: OI-1 FTE and dated
Long-lead items to start early (§5) · status (§3, §6)
Across all phases · R-01 single-maintainer bottleneck:
every WP-M-02 role resolves to one person, who is the critical path and cannot review their own work (§4.3); B-11 recruits reviewers.
Next-30-days backlog (§9): status as written in the table
Panda host + mutation tests in CI
Fork CI with safety tests, MISRA, mutation
No public-road use before G1 + WP-V-07
Record VIN, ECU firmware, device rev.
I1 review of impact records and DN-01
“Done” is the backlog status written in §9 (PR numbers in brackets); it is not verification evidence and does not pass any gate.
